one_liner: Brex has a broad REST/OpenAPI API with admin-generated user tokens for Brex customers, partner-only OAuth2 (plus OAuth with DCR on the official hosted MCP server); you need an existing Brex account.
auth_notes: Customers use an admin-generated user token (Bearer) with scopes from Settings → Developer. OAuth2 Authorization Code is for approved partner integrations; the onboarding API uses Client Credentials. The MCP server separately supports OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration for any employee, so per-user OAuth is available via MCP only. Most APIs require an account admin.
access_notes: The pages do not state pricing. GA APIs are available by default to all Brex customers, and an admin must accept the Developer API agreement in the dashboard. A Brex account is required. Partner credentials (staging, OAuth) are issued only after application approval. The pages show no customer sandbox. The earlier 'free of charge' and 'approved business account' quotes were not on the provided pages, so access confidence is low.
blocker_notes: Requires an existing Brex account with an admin who accepts the Developer API agreement and creates tokens (per-customer setup). Multi-tenant OAuth requires partner approval. The MCP server is beta and must be enabled under Beta features.

evidence.quote: Generate one from **Settings → Developer** in the Brex Dashboard.
Most Brex APIs require a Brex admin to grant access.
Partners using the **onboarding API** authenticate with a [Client Credentials Grant](https://oauth.net/2/grant-types/client-credentials/)–there is no user associated with this API access.
We recommend using an existing OAuth 2.0 library to implement the [OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Grant]
Available by default to all Brex customers.
An account admin or card admin must accept the Developer API agreement in **Settings → Developer**.
Once your application is approved, you'll receive credentials for the staging environment using SendSafely.
Send real-time notifications based on events
The server is hosted at `https://api.brex.com/mcp` and supports any MCP-compatible client.
The server supports [Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591)](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7591), so MCP clients don't need to be pre-registered.
